_comment: Single source of truth for machine-readable product facts. Consumed by src/pages/Index.tsx, scripts/prerender.js, and scripts/generate-llms.js so the SoftwareApplication schema, the page copy, and llms.txt can never disagree. AI assistants read these fields verbatim when asked what GERDBuddy is, what it costs, and how it is rated, so EVERY value here must be verifiable against a primary source. Never hand-edit a rating or price to something you have not just checked.

howToReverify: name / rating / version / minimum OS: curl -s 'https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6756620910&country=us'
price / trial: ops/runbooks/trial-toggle.md (App Store Connect product table), cross-checked against RevenueCat (annual + monthly carry a P3D trial)
featureList: must match the shipped App Store description in ops/store-listing/

name: GERDBuddy: Acid Reflux Relief
shortDescription: Track meals and symptoms, scan food and restaurant menus for estimated reflux risk, and explore personal patterns with guided flare support.

screenshots.source: US iTunes Lookup API screenshotUrls, checked 2026-09-30

pricing.summary: Free to download. GERDBuddy Pro is $14.99 per month or $59.99 per year after a 3-day free trial. Cancel anytime.
pricing.source: US prices verified against the live App Store description and confirmed by the owner on 2026-09-30: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gerdbuddy-acid-reflux-relief/id6756620910. The owner confirmed the 3-day trial.

featureList: Meal photos with estimated reflux risk and possible trigger ingredients
Restaurant menu scanning with lower-risk suggestions
Personal trigger associations and confidence scores from logged meals and symptoms
Guided breathing and comfort steps during a flare
differentiators: Combines general reflux information with patterns from your own logs
Designed for support when you need it, without daily-streak mechanics
Scans restaurant menus as well as individual meals
notMedicalAdvice: GERDBuddy is a tracking and information tool. It does not diagnose or treat disease and does not replace medical advice.
